MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.title: Witch factor
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.descript: When you play an attack card, you get 20 layers of  Witch Transformation . When you play a skill or ability card, you get 10 layers of  Witch Transformation . (Sometimes the card may be played automatically)

MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.title: Witch information
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.descrip: When obtained, 26 cards are randomly generated from the prepared witch cards, and any number can be selected to be added to the deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.flavor: There is a large amount of information about material transactions between the island and the mansion, as well as information about the girls in custody. There are also personal information and face photos of Emma and all of them on it. Interpretation seems to take a lot of time
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.selecti: Choose the cards you want to add to your deck
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.title: Disassembled parts

MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.title: safe

Opened safe.
It's a digital combination lock, and there's blood on the numeric keypad.

MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_YALISALINS_HAIRPIN.de: After your card deals damage to an enemy, give it 1 Dark Orange fire color segment. Enemy fire color is tracked in 6 segments: heating at 6 segments upgrades Dark Orange to Dark Red, Dark Red to Crimson, and with 100 or more Witchification, Crimson can become Black-Red Carbonization. At player turn start, if the current enemy has Dark Orange fire color, you may choose 1 card from your draw or discard pile and add it to your hand; if it has Dark Red, gain 1 Energy; if it has Crimson, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity. Only the player who applied that fire color gains these rewards. If all cards are fewer than 13, using a Fire Component additionally links 1 random Arisa card; it costs 0 for this use, and only that random card is burned.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_YALISALINS_HAIRPIN.fl: The small thing in her palm feels like the last safety line that has not burned through.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_YALISALINS_HAIRPIN.fi: Enemy fire color has 6 segments and is tracked independently for each Arisa player. Normal and random damage give Dark Orange fire color; burning a card with Fire Component does not give fire color. Heating does not add new segments, and at 6 segments upgrades the current lowest color: Dark Orange -> Dark Red -> Crimson, and after Witchification, Crimson -> Black-Red. Consuming fire color removes the earliest converted segments first and resolves by color: each Dark Orange gives 4 Block, and every 2 Dark Orange draw 1 card; each Dark Red makes your next non-X card cost 1 less for that use and gives 1 Energy next turn, up to your current max Energy per turn, and every 2 Dark Red immediately gain 1 Energy; each Crimson deals Crimson damage to a random enemy, gives that enemy the same amount of Arisa's Magic, then increases Crimson damage by 1, and every 2 Crimson deal the second Crimson segment's damage again and gain 1 Strength. At player turn start, the current enemy's Dark Orange, Dark Red, and Crimson fire colors grant card retrieval, Energy, and Strength plus Dexterity.
When consumed: gain 4 Block for each Dark Orange segment. For every 2 Dark Orange consumed, draw 1 card.

When consumed: each Dark Red segment makes your next non-X card cost 1 less for that use and gives 1 Energy next turn. Energy next turn from this effect is capped each turn by your current max Energy. For every 2 Dark Red consumed, immediately gain 1 Energy.

When consumed: each Crimson segment deals {Damage} damage to a random enemy and gives that much Arisa's Magic, then Crimson damage increases by 1. For every 2 Crimson consumed, deal the second Crimson segment's damage again and gain 1 Strength.
A special fire color after Witchification. It is cashed out by Witchification and Black-Red-specific effects.
Choose 1 card to add to your hand
When you would consume the highest fire color, you may consume 2 lower fire color segments instead.
